Package ucmism2t.services

Class DateTimeService

java.lang.Object
ucmism2t.services.DateTimeService
public class DateTimeService extends Object
Date and Time Service for Acceleo Templates Provides ISO 8601 formatted date/time strings for use in generated code, documentation headers, timestamps, etc. ISO 8601 Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss Example: 2025-02-13T14:30:45 Usage in Acceleo templates: when registered in Java code [aModel.getCurrentDateTime/] with [import ucmism2t::services::DateTimeService /] im mtl files [aModel.getCurrentDateTime()/]
Since:
Java 21

  • Method Details

    • getCurrentDateTime

      public String getCurrentDateTime(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context)
      Returns the current date and time in ISO 8601 format (local time). This uses the system's default timezone. Example in Acceleo template: // Generated on [model.getCurrentDateTime/] Output example: // Generated on 2025-02-13T14:30:45
      Parameters:
      context - The model element (required by Acceleo, but not used)
      Returns:
      Current date/time as ISO 8601 string (local timezone)

    • getCurrentDateTimeUTC

      public String getCurrentDateTimeUTC(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context)
      Returns the current date and time in ISO 8601 format (UTC). This always returns UTC time, regardless of system timezone. Useful for timestamps that need to be timezone-independent. Example in Acceleo template: // Generated on [model.getCurrentDateTimeUTC/] UTC Output example: // Generated on 2025-02-13T13:30:45 UTC
      Parameters:
      context - The model element (required by Acceleo, but not used)
      Returns:
      Current date/time as ISO 8601 string in UTC

    • getCurrentDateTimeWithZone

      public String getCurrentDateTimeWithZone(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context)
      Returns the current date and time with timezone offset. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+HH:MM Example: 2025-02-13T14:30:45+01:00 Useful when timezone information needs to be preserved.
      Parameters:
      context - The model element (required by Acceleo, but not used)
      Returns:
      Current date/time as ISO 8601 string with timezone

    • formatCurrentDateTime

      public String formatCurrentDateTime(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context, String pattern)
      Formats a custom date-time string with specified pattern. Pattern examples: "yyyy-MM-dd" -> 2025-02-13 "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm" -> 13/02/2025 14:30 "EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy" -> Thursday, February 13, 2025 Example in Acceleo template: [model.formatCurrentDateTime('yyyy-MM-dd')/]
      Parameters:
      context - The model element (required by Acceleo, but not used)
      pattern - DateTimeFormatter pattern
      Returns:
      Formatted current date/time
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If pattern is invalid
